Article Title: US restores $600 million for Gavi vaccine alliance, keeps WHO cut off
Article Text:
During his first term in 2020, Trump temporarily suspended US funding to the organisation.

The United States has approved the release of $600 million in funding for Gavi, the global vaccine alliance, but has decided that none of the money will be routed through the World Health Organization (WHO), dealing another financial setback to the UN health agency.In a joint statement, the US Department of State and the Department of Health and Human Services said the US government would not provide funding to the WHO through Gavi.The decision follows directions issued by President Donald Trump, who asked Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and secretary of state Marco Rubio to negotiate reforms with Gavi before any long-term US support is restored.Republican Senator Susan Collins, who had urged the administration to resume funding for the international immunisation programme, welcomed the move.According to the State Department, Gavi has agreed to work with its governing board and partner countries to gradually replace vaccines containing mercury with mercury-free alternatives. The latest decision continues Trump's long-running dispute with the WHO.During his first term in 2020, Trump temporarily suspended US funding to the organisation, accusing it of mishandling the Covid-19 pandemic and amplifying what he called China's "disinformation" about the virus.He argued that the WHO's actions contributed to the wider spread of the outbreak.At the time, the United States was the WHO's largest financial contributor, providing more than $400 million in 2019, which accounted for about 15 per cent of the organisation's budget.On the first day of his second term on January 20, 2025, Trump announced that the US would withdraw from the WHO and halted American financial contributions to the agency.Health experts have said the administration's decisions appear to be driven more by ideological considerations than by strategic public health priorities.The WHO receives funding through mandatory contributions from member states as well as voluntary donations from governments and other partners.With an annual budget of about $3.4 billion, the WHO operates on significantly fewer resources than the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, which received $9.3 billion in core funding in 2023.The organisation uses its funding to support vaccination campaigns and programmes to prevent and treat diseases such as polio, tuberculosis, HIV, malaria and measles, particularly in countries with limited healthcare systems.It also coordinates emergency health responses in conflict-affected regions, including Gaza, Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, among others.
Article Summary: The United States has approved the release of $600 million in funding for Gavi, the global vaccine alliance. But it has decided that none of the money will be routed through the World Health Organization (WHO) The decision follows directions issued by President Donald Trump. During his first term in 2020, Trump temporarily suspended US funding to the organisation.

Article Title: Seattle police chief Shon Barnes fired over absence during mass shooting that killed 3
Article Text:
Seattle Police Chief was reportedly relieved of his duties

Why was Shon Barnes removed?

Who is Shon Barnes?

Barnes' policing strategy in Seattle

Seattle Police Chief Shon Barnes was relieved of his duties by Mayor Katie Wilson on Wednesday, days after the department came under scrutiny over its response to the deadly Bite of Seattle mass shooting.Barnes was asked to resign following a meeting with the mayor after attending a silent vigil for the shooting victims, FOX 13 Seattle reported citing multiple sources.The report said Barnes later began informing people via text messages that he had been dismissed.Barnes had been scheduled to sit down for one-on-one interviews with Seattle media on Wednesday, but those appearances were canceled shortly before the reported meeting with Wilson.The reported decision comes after widespread criticism of the Seattle Police Department's handling of the Bite of Seattle shooting.On Sunday, a mass shooting at the Seattle Center during the annual food festival left three people dead and several others injured. Barnes was out of town at the time, attending the National Organization of Black Law Enforcement Executives (NOBLE) conference in Dallas.The police department waited several hours before holding its first media briefing on the shooting.Assistant Chief Tyrone Davis led the briefing, while Barnes was absent. He returned to Seattle and appeared alongside Mayor Katie Wilson at a press conference the following morning.After that briefing, Barnes was involved in a tense exchange with a reporter who questioned his absence from the city during the shooting and reports that he was frequently away from Seattle.Barnes was appointed Seattle police chief in 2024 by then-Mayor Bruce Harrell and officially took charge in 2025, succeeding interim chief Sue Rahr.Before moving to Seattle, he served as chief of the Madison Police Department in Wisconsin.Earlier in his career, Barnes held senior law enforcement positions in Chicago, Salisbury, North Carolina, and Greensboro, North Carolina.During his tenure in Madison, the department reported declines in violent and property crime while increasing the representation of women officers.After taking office, Barnes introduced what he called "Seattle-Centric Policing," a data-driven strategy aimed at tackling neighbourhood-specific crime trends, including gun violence and property crime.The initiative focused on coordination between police, local government, businesses, schools and community groups.Barnes also launched a community policing pilot programme that assigned dedicated pairs of officers to specific neighbourhoods and held public forums to discuss safety concerns across the city.
Article Summary: Seattle Police Chief Shon Barnes was reportedly relieved of his duties by Mayor Katie Wilson on Wednesday. The decision comes after widespread criticism of the Seattle Police Department's handling of the Bite of Seattle shooting. On Sunday, a mass shooting at the Seattle Center during the annual food festival left three people dead and several others injured.

Article Title: Delhi Mosque Demolition: Delhi Demolition Drive Near Faiz-e-Elahi Mosque: Police Clash During MCD Action
Article Text:
Delhi demolition drive: MCD carries out action near Faiz-e-Elahi mosque following HC order; 5 cops injured in stone pelting

Delhi: 5 Cops Injured, 10 Detained As Anti-Encroachment Drive Near Mosque Turns Violent

Demolition drive at Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque near Turkman Gate in Delhi on Wednesday. Image Credit: Tarun Rawat/TNN







NEW DELHI: Multiple police personnel were injured during a demolition drive in central Delhi early on Wednesday after locals and miscreants attacked them with stones.The police is trying to identify the miscreants who engaged in stone-pelting and will initiate strict action against them.Delhi Police have registered an FIR against unknown persons and around 10 people have been detained for questioning so far, officials said.Police are scanning CCTV footage, ground visuals and body-camera recordings to identify those involved in the attack on the police team.While the FIR has been lodged against unidentified persons, investigators said four to five suspects have already been identified and further legal action will follow.Special commissioner (Law and Order) Ravindra Yadav said that the action started around 1 am."MCD conducted demolition as per the high court's orders on the encroached land. Stones were pelted at the police at night. We used minimal force to push back."DCP (Central) Nidhin Valsan said, "The action is still ongoing. We deployed our staff for security. 4 to 5 officers suffered minor injuries. As soon as we get the CCTV camera footage, ground footage, and body camera footage, we will identify the miscreants and take legal action."The demolition was carried out by the MCD to remove illegal constructions around the Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque in the Turkman Gate area. The drive kicked off around 1 am, with around 17 bulldozers pressed into service.The action followed an order of the Delhi High Court, which declared a dispensary and a community hall adjoining the mosque illegal and directed their removal.The administration appealed to local residents to maintain peace.Anticipating major disruptions, the Delhi Traffic Police also issued a traffic advisory, warning of congestion on several key roads on Wednesday. Traffic around Ramlila Maidan and adjoining areas is expected to remain affected through the day.
Article Summary: 5 cops injured in stone pelting during demolition drive in central Delhi. Police are trying to identify the miscreants who engaged in stone-pelting. The demolition was carried out by MCD to remove illegal constructions around the Faiz-e-Ilahi Mosque in the Turkman Gate area.

Article Title: Laxmi Nagar assault: New clip shows SUV crashing into house; accused Omkar Yadav claims self-defence in viral video
Article Text: NEW DELHI: Another CCTV clip related to the Laxmi Nagar assault has surfaced, showing a group of men arriving first, opening a gate and assaulting a man. Moments later, a Thar SUV was seen speeding towards the house and crashing into the wall, after which several men got out of it and the assault continued. Meanwhile, accused Omkar Yadav has released a video on social media defending his brother, gym caretaker and key accused Satish Yadav alias Pintu Yadav.A dispute over a gym operating from a residential property in east Delhi's Laxmi Nagar allegedly escalated into the assault recently when the man was beaten up, his wife was said to be molested, and their son was stripped and assaulted on the street.The man runs a gym from the basement of his house and caretaker Yadav allegedly cheated him and attempted to take over the business, leading to the dispute. On Jan 2, during an argument over a basement- and sewage-related issue, Yadav, along with his associates, assaulted the couple and their son, a senior officer said.An earlier CCTV footage had shown the couple's son being dragged onto the road, stripped and beaten up by a group of four-five men. The presence of police personnel in parts of the footage also raised questions. Police claimed the assault stopped after they arrived while the victims alleged that they were beaten up in full view of the cops, a claim that is being verified.According to the complaint, the couple's son came out after hearing the commotion and was assaulted. The couple also said their two sons had left the house following the attack.Police said main accused Yadav was arrested while the other accused were absconding. Omkar, one of the absconding accused, posted a video on social media, saying his brother had been working with the complainant for "20-25 years" and was running the gym for the past "12-13 years". He questioned why objections over the gym were raised only in the past five-six months. "If we captured the land, why did she start complaining only now?" he asked.Omkar further alleged that the legal proceedings were "one-sided" and claimed that he was also being targeted. He identified himself as a worker of a party and alleged that he was being defamed by an opposition party.Referring to the incident, Omkar said, "On Jan 2, I got a call from my brother. I reached the spot after 10-15 minutes. If I am seen kicking two or three times in the video, it was in self-defence. They started hitting first."A case has been registered at the Laxmi Nagar police station under various provisions of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, including voluntarily causing hurt, wrongful restraint, criminal trespass, assault or use of criminal force to outrage the modesty of a woman, acts intended to insult a woman's modesty and criminal intimidation.
Article Summary: A dispute over a gym operating from a residential property in east Delhi's Laxmi Nagar allegedly escalated into the assault. The man runs a gym from the basement of his house and caretaker Yadav allegedly cheated him and attempted to take over the business. On Jan 2, during an argument over a basement- and sewage- related issue, Yadav along with his associates, assaulted the couple and their son.

Article Title: 'My father was almost lynched': Families of injured cops during CJP protest speak out
Article Text: NEW DELHI: "My father was almost lynched," said the daughter of a police personnel injured during the CJP protest said at a press meet on Friday, while recalling the violence that broke out on July 20.She said her father, who had served in the Indian Navy for 15 years, was deployed at the front line near the barricades during the protest."Before joining the police, my father served as a Marine Commando in the Indian Navy. He dedicated 15 years of his life to the Indian Navy. My father was present at the main protest site. He was on the front line near the barricades, where there was a large crowd, " the daughter of a Delhi Police SI who sustained injuries during the protest told ANI.She also said that when her father returned home, he told the family that the situation no longer appeared to be a protest, as anti-social elements had entered the scene."Whenever my father came home at night, he used to say that the protest no longer seemed like a student protest. Many antisocial elements had become involved in it. The very next day, on the 25th, my father was pulled by a rowdy mob and was almost lynched near the stage at Jantar Mantar.This happened on the 25th at around 2:00pm. He remained unconscious at RML Hospital for about four hours. Around 10:00pm, his colleagues brought him home, and his uniform was completely stained with blood. It was extremely painful for us to see him in that condition, " she said."When I opened social media, I saw that my father was being called a criminal. The very next day, I came to know that the people who had attacked my father were approaching the Supreme Court to wash away their crimes and were filing complaints against him and all the police personnel. I felt very hurt and decided that I should also seek justice for my father. I received support from other police families, and we went to the Supreme Court. We requested an advocate to present our case before the Hon’ble Supreme Court. The advocate assured us that we, too, have equal rights as citizens of this country and that we would also get justice, " said added.She alleged that later, around 2pm, he was attacked, pulled by a mob, and narrowly escaped being lynched.Another family member also spoke about the incident.The wife of a Delhi Police ACP, who was injured during the clash between police personnel and CJP protesters, said that seeing her husband return home injured was an extremely painful and traumatic experience for her and their two-year-old daughter."The moment he returned home late on the night of July 20, injured as he was, was incredibly painful and traumatic for both me and my two-year-old daughter. I am accompanied here by other family members of Delhi Police personnel, and we wish to share our ordeal with you," the ACP's wife said.She said the families of the injured personnel wanted to highlight their experiences and share the difficulties they faced following the violence."The miscreants who attempted to disrupt the students' protest, tarnish its image, and undermine the dignity of Parliament should be held accountable for their actions and should not be spared. At the same time, the students should be released after their records are verified," another family member of an injured policeman told ANI.The families of the injured personnel addressed a press briefing on Friday, condemning the violence and expressing concern over the safety of officers on duty.The kin of the injured police personnel alleged that the situation escalated beyond a peaceful demonstration, putting the lives of security personnel at risk.They criticised the violence during the Gen Z-led protest and questioned the attacks on police personnel who were carrying out their responsibilities.
Article Summary: The families of the injured personnel addressed a press briefing on Friday. They condemned the violence and expressed concern over the safety of officers on duty. The kin of injured police personnel alleged that the situation escalated beyond a peaceful demonstration, putting the lives of security personnel at risk. They criticised the violence during the Gen Z-led protest.

Article Title: Shraddha Walkar murder case: Brother moves HC over delayed trial; says family awaiting last rites
Article Text:
(With agency inputs)





NEW DELHI: The brother of Shraddha Walkar has moved the Delhi high court, seeking directions for the time-bound completion of the trial in the sensational 2022 murder case.He alleged that repeated delays have denied the family justice and prevented them from performing her last rites, as her mortal remains continue to be retained as case property.The petition is listed for hearing on Friday before a Bench of Justice Madhu Jain.The writ petition has been filed by Shreejay Vikas Walkar, brother of the deceased, through Advocate Seema Kushwaha, seeking a direction to the trial court to conclude the sessions trial pending before the Additional Sessions Judge (FTC), Saket Courts, within a fixed timeframe.The petition has been filed under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).The petition states that the criminal trial has remained pending for an inordinately long period despite substantial progress in recording evidence. It argues that the delay has undermined the constitutional guarantee of a speedy trial under Article 21 and caused continuing hardship to the victim's family.The plea states that the dismembered body parts recovered during the investigation continue to remain in the custody of the investigating agency and the trial court as material exhibits.As a result, the family has been unable to perform Shraddha Walkar's last rites or give her a dignified farewell. It contends that the right to dignity under Article 21 extends to the dignified treatment and disposal of the dead, and that the continued retention of her mortal remains due to the pendency of the trial amounts to a continuing constitutional injury.The petition further states that although the Sessions Court, on July 6, 2024, directed that the case be disposed of expeditiously and that proceedings be conducted on a day-to-day basis, repeated adjournments have defeated the purpose of that order. It also alleges that the accused has repeatedly challenged the trial court's orders before the Delhi High Court with the intention of delaying the proceedings.Referring to the present stage of the trial, the petitioner states that out of 221 prosecution witnesses, 171 have already been examined while 50 witnesses remain to be examined. Despite this substantial progress, the trial has not concluded, the plea said.The petition further states that the victim's father passed away during the pendency of the trial without seeing the proceedings conclude or being able to perform his daughter's last rites.It says Shraddha Walkar's brother is now pursuing the matter as the surviving legal representative, with the expectation that justice should not be defeated by delay.Among the reliefs sought, the petitioner has requested the High Court to direct the trial court to conclude the proceedings within a fixed period, refrain from granting unnecessary adjournments except in exceptional circumstances recorded in writing, and pass any other appropriate orders in the interest of justice.The petition clarifies that it does not seek any direction on the merits of the prosecution or the defence and is confined to securing the expeditious conclusion of the trial so that the mortal remains can be released for the performance of the last rites.The sensational Shraddha Walkar murder case pertains to the alleged killing of 27-year-old Shraddha Walkar by her live-in partner, Aaftab Amin Poonawala, in Delhi in May 2022.The prosecution alleges that Poonawala strangled Walkar, dismembered her body, stored the remains in a refrigerator, and disposed of them at various locations across the city. The trial is currently pending before the Saket District Courts.
Article Summary: Shraddha Walkar's brother has moved the Delhi high court, seeking directions for the time-bound completion of the trial in the sensational 2022 murder case. He alleged that repeated delays have denied the family justice and prevented them from performing her last rites. The petition is listed for hearing on Friday.

Article Title: Google provides incorrect information to Kangana Ranaut: CJP's Saurav Das
Article Text: NEW DELHI: Countering BJP MP Kangana Ranaut 's remarks about his age and professional life, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) chief spokesperson Saurav Das said he has never claimed to be an active student, adding that even Google provides inaccurate information about him to the parliamentarian."Even Google provides incorrect information to Kangana Ranaut . It suggests I am 28, but I am actually 27. I am not a student either; Google would confirm that I am not a student. I am a journalist, and I have never claimed to be an active student. I am a student of life. She should also strive to be one, " Saurav Das told ANI.Saurav Das said that even Google provides incorrect information to Kangana Ranaut, as it wrongly lists him as 28 years old when he is actually 27.Das said Google would confirm that he is not a student but a journalist.He added that he has never claimed to be an active student and described himself as "a student of life", remarking that Kangana Ranaut should also strive to be one.Earlier, Ranaut, the Lok Sabha MP from Mandi, described Das as a "28-year-old useless and unemployed" in an Instagram Story.BJP MP in her Instagram story had lashed out at Saurav Das saying, "Googled this student and he is 28, how he claims himself to be a student I have no clue! Yes, I am in politics for the past 2 years, but I have been in public life for the last 20 years.At his age, I had 2 National Awards. Yes, as a new parliamentarian, I was overwhelmed with all the work because I am also a filmmaker, performing artist, producer, screenwriter, and entrepreneur. "Taking further swipe, she added, "You are not a student; you are simply useless. Let's start with learning some skill. It's a good place to start," she added.Reacting to the use of derogatory remarks by some CJP protesters during the NEET paper leak protest, Saurav Das said that if any language used was derogatory in nature, the person concerned was free to pursue civil and criminal defamation proceedings against the individual responsible."If any language used was derogatory in nature, then the person concerned is free to pursue civil and criminal defamation proceedings against the individual concerned. However, the use of the criminal justice machinery against protesters is highly condemnable, and no one should be punished merely for using objectionable language," he said.Das further urged young people to exercise restraint in their choice of words while reiterating his opposition to criminal action over such remarks."The language may be wrong, and it may be objectionable to someone, but that is no reason to invoke the criminal justice machinery against such people. It creates a chilling effect. I don't think this is acceptable to anybody, especially the younger generation, " Das said."I would request the younger generation to be very careful about the words they use and the kind of insults or remarks they make against people in general. That said, the use of the criminal justice machinery is a big no-no. It is completely unacceptable and should not happen. We would also like to tell the police to remain calm and not misuse their powers for any political ends, " he added.Meanwhile, a Zero FIR has been registered against a woman at the Expressway Police Station in Noida over allegedly making derogatory remarks about the Prime Minister during the protest over the NEET paper leak at Delhi's Jantar Mantar on July 23, 2026.A case has been registered against the accused, Ruchika Singh.According to the complaint, her remarks undermined the dignity of the Prime Minister's constitutional office and were made with the deliberate intent to incite ill-will and disturb public peace.
Article Summary: Saurav Das said that even Google provides incorrect information to Kangana Ranaut. He added that he has never claimed to be an active student and described himself as "a student of life" Das urged young people to exercise restraint in their choice of words while reiterating his opposition to criminal action.

Article Title: Man held 3 years after ‘rape-blackmail’
Article Text:
New Delhi:





A 39-year-old man has been arrested three years after he had allegedly raped a woman at gunpoint, recorded her obscene photos and videos, and blackmailed her into repeated sexual exploitation.Mudit alias Rajvir Chawla was arrested from Nangloi Wednesday. Chawla, who was declared an absconder by a court in Jan last year, had allegedly changed his name and frequently shifted hideouts across cities to evade arrest.DCP (crime) Chandra Kumar Singh said an FIR was registered on Sept 19, 2024, following the woman’s complaint. She alleged that Chawla had befriended her family after meeting her husband in Tihar Jail and gained her trust by asking her to treat him as a younger brother. In July 2023, he allegedly called her to his house, threatened her three-year-old son with a firearm, rendered her unconscious with an injection and raped her. He used her photos and video recordings to sexually exploit her repeatedly, the officer said.Police said Chawla initially tried to conceal his identity after his arrest, but finally admitted his involvement. With seven previous criminal cases, he was also declared a proclaimed offender in a cheating case in Maharashtra’s Nagpur.
Article Summary: Mudit alias Rajvir Chawla was arrested from Nangloi Wednesday. He was declared an absconder by a court in Jan last year. He allegedly changed his name and frequently shifted hideouts across cities to evade arrest. Police said he initially tried to conceal his identity after his arrest.

Article Title: Sessions Court Rejects Anticipatory Bail for Juhu Teen in Prabhadevi Assault Case
Article Text:
The court refused to extend the benefit of probation





Mumbai: A sessions court on Thursday observed that the charges invoked against a 19-year-old Juhu resident, including criminal intimidation, are classified as bailable under the new criminal laws, but refused anticipatory bail after noting the seriousness of the assault allegations and the alleged pressure on the complainant’s family. The court rejected the plea submitted by Arjun Khanna , who is accused of orchestrating a violent assault on two brothers and their security staff during a late-night party in Prabhadevi. The plea was opposed by Kaykasshan Patel, former actor and mother of the victims Arhan Patel, aged 19, and Numaire Patel, aged 15, through her lawyer Satish Maneshinde. “…victim is 19 years old and 15 years old, having no father. The applicant (Khanna) allegedly assaulted fist blows on the face of 15 years old boy which is serious in nature. As per the allegation, the fist blow was given by the friend of the applicant on the nose of the informant and caused him nose bleeding injury and also pulled his hand forcefully, that he suffered shoulder dislocation injury. Not only this, the applicant and his friends threatened to kill the informant while pressing his neck,” judge Judge SB DigeThe father of the victims, businessman Areef Patel, died in 2019.The prosecution case was that on July 18, during a late-night party in the parking area of Chaitanya Tower at Prabhadevi, the brothers were leaving with bodyguards when an altercation allegedly began after Arhan Patel gestured goodbye to Aditya Agarwal.According to the FIR, Khanna questioned Agarwal if Arhan was his friend, pushed Arhan, and thereafter an unidentified person punched him on the nose, causing bleeding, and pulled his hand, allegedly causing a shoulder injury.The FIR further alleged that another person issued a threat to kill and that Khanna and two others assaulted bodyguard Mohsin. When Numaire stepped out of the car and questioned the assault, Khanna allegedly caught hold of Numaire’s hair, punched Numaire on the face, abused and threatened Numaire. The FIR also stated that when friend Shene Iglesias tried to intervene, Khanna allegedly assaulted Iglesias, causing a bleeding injury.Khanna’s defence argued that the case was falsely exaggerated from a non-cognisable dispute into a grievous hurt case, and that there was no medical material showing a nose fracture or shoulder dislocation. The defence also argued that Arhan was allegedly intoxicated, that the building had CCTV cameras and watchmen but no supporting material had emerged, and that nothing was required to be recovered from Khanna.Maneshinde argued that Khanna had allegedly assaulted the complainant, minor brother, bodyguard and friend without reason, and that more serious offences were made out than those mentioned in the FIR. The intervenor also alleged that Khanna’s family was influential and that the police were not investigating properly, leading the complainant to approach the Bombay High Court for transfer of investigation to the State CID or another independent agency.The court also took note of a written complaint filed by the complainant’s mother alleging pressure on the family.
Article Summary: Arjun Khanna is accused of orchestrating a violent assault on two brothers and their security staff during a late-night party in Prabhadevi. The court refused anticipatory bail after noting the seriousness of the assault allegations and the alleged pressure on the complainant’s family.

Article Title: Police launch inquiry into drunk driving FIR against Mumbai's stroke victim
Article Text:
A 73-year-old man who suffered a stroke while driving his car was kept at Versova police station for allegedly five hours.





MUMBAI: A departmental inquiry has been initiated into a drunk driving FIR registered by the Versova police against 73-year-old Versova-resident Sharad Kadam, who dashed his car into another on July 25, said police.The inquiry was initiated by zonal DCP Purushottam Karad after TOI published the article “Man suffers stroke, gets held up for drunk driving, lands in ICU” on Thursday.The inquiry was conducted by an assistant commissioner of police (ACP), who gathered details of the case from officers or cops who had registered the FIR. The Versova police waited for the blood test report to know the alcohol content in his blood.DCP Karad did not respond to TOI’s message on Thursday regarding the inquiry assigned to an ACP-rank officer.“Details will be gathered from hospitals at Cooper and at Nanavati to know the current medical condition of Kadam. Probe will also be done to know if Kadam had actually suffered a stroke and there was medical negligence on behalf of the cops. The ACP is also waiting for the blood report to find out whether Kadam drove his car under the influence of alcohol. His family members maintain he suffered a stroke,” said a police source from the Versova police station.MLA Ameet Satam said he received acknowledgement from the DCP that an inquiry was initiated and a senior officer was asked to submit the report at the earliest.“A Nanavati Hospital medical report, issued on July 26, confirmed that he tested negative for alcohol. So it is a clear case of negligence by cops and wrong FIR filed,” said Satam.Agreeing with Satam, Kadam’s nephew Rohan Rathod told TOI: “When a lawyer relative reached the police after learning about the incident, she noticed my uncle was unable to talk or stand with slurry speech. How are the cops claiming that he was drunk.”
Article Summary: A departmental inquiry has been initiated into a drunk driving FIR registered by the Versova police against 73-year-old Sharad Kadam. The inquiry was initiated by zonal DCP Purushottam Karad after TOI published the article ‘Man suffers stroke, gets held up for drunk driving, lands in ICU’ on Thursday.

Article Title: Unions upset as govt announces sudden end of deep-sea fishing ban
Article Text:
The fishermen's unions met state fisheries minister Nitesh Rane over the issue on Thursday evening

TOI





Mumbai: Maharashtra’s fishermen unions expressed anger over the state govt’s announcement that the monsoon ban on deep-sea fishing will end on Aug 1, not Aug 15 as stipulated earlier. Koli fishers say this sudden reversal will mainly benefit commercial operators whose large trawlers are better equipped to venture out quickly, unlike local boatmen.“Traditional fishermen are not prepared to resume fishing yet, whereas wealthy boat owners, who are equipped and ready, will gain an unfair 15-day advantage,” said Devendra Tandel, president of the Akhil Maharashtra Machhimar Kruti Samiti.In May-June, the Kolis were happy after the Maharashtra govt extended the monsoon ban till Aug 15 to preserve marine life and allow fish to breed. However the Central govt had already devised a separate Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) policy for fishing beyond 12 nautical miles, wherein the ban ends July 31. The state govt did not communicate this contradiction to local fishermen.Irate unions met state fisheries minister Nitesh Rane over the issue Thursday evening.Tandel said, “The state govt itself announced a ban until Aug 15. Trusting this decision, thousands of fishermen planned maintenance of their boats, engines, fishing nets and the engagement of crew members.However, at the last moment, the govt has now announced that fishing beyond 12 nautical miles (24 km) will be permitted from Aug 1. If the govt was aware since March that the Centre’s EEZ fishing ban would end on July 31, why weren’t we informed? Moreover, fisheries laws are enacted not for fishermen but for the fish which need to be conserved and protected. Fish do not know the 12 nautical mile concept. They are migratory in nature.”Versova Koli leader Pradeep Tapke said local boats are idling because the owners have been planning to repair and paint them by Aug 15. “We cannot suddenly rise and head out to sea Aug 1. Riding a boat is not like driving a car where you just fill petrol and start the engine. Each trip calls for planned investment, diesel stocks, labourers, food and equipment. The authorities should plan better.”Kalina Koli leader Nayana Patil asked if the govt would compensate fishers who court danger by venturing out to sea amid stormy weather before Aug 15.The minister toldthat the ban till Aug 15 remains in force within 12 nautical miles (state boundary).Fishermen point out that they are protesting against the Centre’s simultaneous decision to permit deep-sea fishing beyond that limit. That will indeed resume on Aug 1.
Article Summary: Maha's fishermen unions expressed anger over the state govt’s announcement that the monsoon ban on deep-sea fishing will end on Aug 1, not Aug 15. Koli fishers say this sudden reversal will mainly benefit commercial operators whose large trawlers are better equipped to venture out quickly.

Article Title: Bacchu Kadu meets Dipke, backs agitation, says ‘era of threats is over’
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Days after Maharashtra minister Sanjay Shirsat visited Abhijeet Dipke’s residence, Shiv Sena MLC Bacchu Kadu on Thursday met the Cockroach Janata Party founder and hailed his agitation, saying he had come “not as a politician but as an agitator”.Kadu is now the second Mahayuti politician to meet Dipke, who has been sharply critical of both BJP-led state and central govts.Speaking to reporters after the meeting at Dipke’s residence, Kadu said Dipke was unwell and running a fever, limiting any detailed discussion.“I came only to meet him personally. I have not come here as a leader, but as an agitator. Whenever someone from among us fights for a cause, it is necessary to stand with him and congratulate him. Politics and party affiliations are secondary,” Kadu said.Addressing Dipke’s allegations that he had received threats, Kadu said politicians should ensure such incidents do not occur.“The era of issuing threats is over. If anyone is threatening him, BJP functionaries should take note of it and act,” he said.Kadu rejected speculation that the meeting signalled any political realignment. “People can have different ideologies.Even govts are formed by parties with varying ideologies. Supporting an agitation does not mean endorsing every political stand,” he said.Defending public protests as a democratic right, Kadu said agitations often become necessary when grievances remain unresolved. “I too have come from movements. If concerns are not addressed despite raising them within the system, people have every right to protest. Agitation is not a crime,” he said, adding that he himself had faced more than 350 criminal cases stemming from protests.On the issue of farm loan waivers, Kadu claimed govt would ensure farmers received the full benefit of the scheme.“Government will bear the principal amount while banks will waive the interest component,” he said, adding that beneficiaries left out of certain schemes linked to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Mahatma Phule would be included after additional budgetary allocations.Commenting on recruitment and examination controversies, Kadu stressed the need for greater transparency in the selection process. “Young people should never feel that only those with money or influence can secure govt jobs. If recruitment is not fair, protests become inevitable,’ he said.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena MLC Bacchu Kadu met Cockroach Janata Party founder Abhijeet Dipke. Kadu is now the second Mahayuti politician to meet Dipke, who has been sharply critical of both BJP-led state and central govts.

Article Title: If we were funded from abroad, Amit Shah should quit; I refused offer to join BJP: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke
Article Text:
Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, along with spokesperson Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka

:





CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGARCockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke on Thursday claimed that BJP functionaries approached him with an offer to join the party during the Jantar Mantar student agitation, and threatened him and his family when he refused.“Join us, or we will deal with you,” Dipke claimed he was told during the protest. He further alleged that threats were extended to his parents when he declined the offer.“No matter how many offers they make, I will not join BJP,” he said.Escalating his attack on Centre, Dipke said Union home minister Amit Shah should resign if allegations that CJP is being funded or operated from abroad are true. “If CJP is indeed being funded or operated from abroad while Amit Shah is in charge, then he has failed as home minister and should resign,” he said.Referring to the alleged threats, Dipke questioned why senior politicians were targeting him.“I am of the age of the Prime Minister and Amit Shah’s grandchildren. How many threats will they issue to a 30-year-old?” he said.Senior BJP functionary and revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule, however, dismissed Dipke’s claim. The neta instead appealed to Dipke to identify the member and promised to take instant action against him.“We have nearly 13 crore members across the country, and he (Dipke) should just identify the person who has threatened him. We will take instant action against the person. If he is unable to identify or name the person, he should then stop maligning our party image,” Bawankule said during an interaction with the media in Thane on Thursday.Dipke also alleged that the police action against student protesters at Jantar Mantar on July 20, in which several demonstrators were injured, could not have taken place without Shah’s approval.Targeting newly appointed Union education minister Pralhad Joshi, Dipke questioned his “values and integrity” and criticised remarks attributed to him regarding the Bilkis Bano case. He also accused BJP of protecting “goons and rapists”, while referring to cases involving Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh and former BJP MLA Kuldeep Singh Sengar.Reacting to Yoga guru Baba Ramdev’s reported criticism of Generation Z, Dipke defended young people and said they were fighting for legitimate rights.“These are future voters and future leaders of the country. There is no point trolling Gen Z for their political views. Baba Ramdev should focus on selling his products,” he said.Dipke also said that police personnel should not fear being filmed if they were acting within the law. “The police belong to the nation, not to any political party. They should function according to the Constitution. If they want to follow BJP’s directions instead, they should remove the khaki uniform and stand guard outside the BJP office,” he alleged.
Article Summary: Abhijeet Dipke claims he was offered to join the party during the Jantar Mantar protest. He also alleged that threats were extended to his parents when he declined the offer. Senior BJP functionary and revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule, however, dismissed Dipke’s claim.
